description: This file defines a feature for retrieving user details by username in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes a query model, validation, and a handler that fetches user data from the database, generates a JWT token, and returns an envelope with user information.

classes.name: Details
classes.description: Contains nested classes for user detail query, validation, and handling within the 'Details' feature.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the query to retrieve user details by username, throws NotFound exception if user does not exist, otherwise generates a JWT token and returns user information.
